title: When clinging builds a throne
subtitle: For desire that is becoming identity
description: The shabad equalizes pleasure and pain, gold and copper, praise and slander. This path lets attachment lose the power to crown the self.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The sanctuary of the Lord makes possession too small to define the soul.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When desire starts telling you who you are, set it beside the Lord’s sanctuary until it shrinks.

evidence.coreClaim: This path exposes the moment attachment stops loving and starts constructing an ego around what it wants.
evidence.turn: Ego weakens when praise and possession are no longer allowed to name reality.
evidence.practicalImplication: Ask what self-image this desire is protecting, then release one demand attached to that image.
